svg.title: Atom Plasma (ViVia Technologies): a KDE Plasma 6 rice driven by the wallpaper, with a shell and a launcher of its own.
svg.desc: The desktop with its Claude usage widget, Atom's orbital launcher, its Theme page and live system meters on three wallpapers, each with the palette the rice computed from it.
